text: The government is using COVID-19 vaccines to microchip Americans.

room.label: U.S. adult citizens
room.questionWording: The U.S. government is using the COVID-19 vaccine to microchip the population.

truthSource.label: FDA, COVID-19 Vaccines Myths vs Facts
truthSource.oneLine: FDA states COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips, and each vaccine’s ingredients are published in its fact sheet.

lesson.tip: Ask what the claim would require: a hidden device in every dose that no lab testing vaccines has found. Ingredient lists are public.
